tasks.final_text: Tower 333 is a 20-story high-rise office building in the central business distric of Bellevue, Washington, United States. The building housed the corporate office of Expedia, Inc. from 2008 to 2019. Amazon is planned to take over the lease for the entire building in 2020.
I had a lovely breakfast this morning. It was soup with rice and salmon. I also had some blackberries which I love. I made tea with sugar which is my favorite combo.
